method: Detail/lighting metrics measured on the image resized to 1024 px long side (Lanczos; smaller images as-is). detail_mean_abs_laplacian = mean |4-neighbour Laplacian| of L*; edge_density = share of pixels whose Sobel gradient of L* exceeds 4 or 10 L* units; warm = chroma>10 and hue 340-100 deg; green = 100-160; cool = 160-340. highlight/shadow decile = mean colour of brightest/darkest 10% of pixels. luminance_centroid_xy = L*-weighted centroid, 0..1 from top-left.
